options.name: algorithm
options.description: Algorithm number. https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2535#section-3.2 Required for C(type=CERT) when C(state=present). Required for C(type=KEY) when C(state=present). Required for C(type=SSHFP) when C(state=present).

options.name: api_env
options.description: Defines which api should be used.

options.name: cert_key_tag
options.description: 16 bit value computed for the key embedded in the certificate as specified in the DNSSEC Standard [RFC 2535]. https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2535#section-4.1.6 Required for C(type=CERT) when C(state=present).

options.name: cert_type
options.description: Certificate Type. https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2538.html#section-2.1 Required for C(type=CERT) when C(state=present).

options.name: cert_usage
options.description: Certificate usage number. https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6698#section-2.1.1 Required for C(type=TLSA) when C(state=present).

options.name: domain
options.description: The name of the Domain to work with (e.g. "example.com").

options.name: flag
options.description: Flag for C(type=CAA) record defining if record is critical. Flag for C(type=NAPTR) record defining the returned record type. Required for C(type=CAA) and C(type=NAPTR) when C(state=present).

options.name: hash
options.description: A hash (ex. SHA-256) in hex digits. Must be at least 56 digits long. Can be an email name for C(type=SMIMEA) Required for C(type=OPENPGPKEY) when C(state=present) Required for C(type=SMIMEA) when C(state=present)

options.name: hash_type
options.description: Hash type number. Required for C(type=SSHFP) and C(type=TLSA) when C(state=present).

options.name: key_flags
options.description: Key Flags Field. https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2535#section-3.1.2 Required for C(type=KEY) when C(state=present).

options.name: key_protocol
options.description: Protocol Octet. https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2535#section-3.1.3 Required for C(type=KEY) when C(state=present).

options.name: matching_type
options.description: Certificate Matching Type. https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6698#section-2.1.3 Required for C(type=SMIMEA) when C(state=present).

options.name: password
options.description: INWX Account Password Required for API authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: Service port. Required for C(type=SRV).

options.name: priority
options.description: Record priority. Required for C(type=MX) and C(type=SRV)

options.name: record
options.description: Record to add. Required if C(state=present).

options.name: regex
options.description: Regex string. Defines what should be replaced with the defined C(substitution). Required for C(type=NAPTR) when C(state=present).

options.name: reversedns
options.description: Whether the record (an IP) should be converted to a reverse dns value. Only works with C(type=PTR).

options.name: selector
options.description: Selector number. https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6698#section-2.1.2 Required for C(type=TLSA) when C(state=present). Required for C(type=SMIMEA) when C(state=present).

options.name: service
options.description: Record service. Required for C(type=SRV).

options.name: solo
options.description: Wether the record should be the only one for that record name and type. Only works with `state=present` This will delete all other records with the same record name and type. When using multiple values, this ensures only the specified records exist.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the record(s) should exist or not.

options.name: substitution
options.description: Substitution string. Replaces everything matching in C(regex) with the defined substitution. Required for C(type=NAPTR) when C(state=present).

options.name: tag
options.description: Tag identifier. An ASCII string that defines the identifier of the property represented by the record. Required for C(type=CAA) when C(state=present).

options.name: ttl
options.description: The TTL to give the new record. Must be between 300 and 864000 seconds.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of DNS record.

options.name: username
options.description: INWX Account Username Required for API authentication.

options.name: value
options.description: The record value. Can be a single value or a list of values for multiple records. When providing a list, multiple records will be created with the same name and type. When using C(solo=true) with multiple values, all existing records of the same name/type will be replaced. Required for C(state=present).

options.name: weight
options.description: Service weight. Required for C(type=SRV) and C(type=NAPTR).
